events.title: Burien Día de los Muertos
events.loc: Burien Community Center , 14700 Sixth Ave. S.W., Burien
events.desc: Ofrendas, crafts, food, music and a chance to honor your ancestors is what this celebration is all about. Join in the free, early evening festival, open to everyone.

events.title: Celebrate Diwali at The Bellevue Collection
events.desc: Families can celebrate Diwali this weekend as you marvel at the intricate rangoli display, bring home a lantern-making craft and watch performances galore. The Festival of Lights takes place on Saturday from noon to 5 p.m., but other activities run all weekend.

events.title: Hip-Hop History Month Celebration at MOPOP
events.loc: Museum of Pop Culture , 325 Fifth Ave. N., Seattle
events.desc: Head to MOPOP for a kid-friendly music and fashion mash-up highlighting the history of hip-hop. Listening sessions, a fashion showcase, and intricate nail design will be part of the day, as will a community clothing drive to support families in need.

events.title: Pumpkin Drop
events.loc: Farrel-McWhirter Park , 19545 N.E. Redmond Rd., Redmond
events.desc: Now that Halloween is over, bring your pristine pumpkins to Farrel-McWhirter Park. Watch the pumpkins get smashed for the animals to enjoy at 12:30 p.m.

events.title: Seattle Festival Orchestra: Sabre Dance
events.loc: Aurora Community Nazarene Church , 1900 N. 175th St., Shoreline
events.desc: Why go to a boring old petting zoo when you can bring your kids to an instrument “petting zoo.” It’s a chance for kids to play with real instruments after being inspired by them at this free concert just for families — one of three this year!

events.title: 61st Annual Veterans Day Parade & Observance
events.loc: Downtown Auburn , 25 W. Main St., Auburn
events.desc: Get your marching band fix (more than 10 are scheduled to perform!) during Auburn’s annual Veterans Day Parade. Four thousand parade participants, plus plenty of military vehicles to fascinate your kids, makes this an easy pick. Activities run all day. The parade starts at 11 a.m.

events.title: Little Beats Concert Series
events.loc: McGilvra Elementary School , 1617 38th Ave. E., Seattle
events.desc: Get in harmony with the all-female Highlight Quartet at this popular family concert series in the city. It’s sure to hit the right note with your music-loving crew.

events.title: Full STEAM Ahead
events.loc: Children’s Museum of Skagit County , 432 Fashion Way, Burlington
events.desc: Head north to the Skagit Valley Children’s Museum and spend the day playing mini-golf on an indoor course, and exploring hands-on STEM activities and exhibits. A FamilyPalooza resource fair is also part of this free community event.

events.title: Sea-Meow Convention
events.loc: Seattle Center Exhibition Hall , 301 Mercer St., Seattle
events.desc: Calling all cat lovers! I’ve got the purr-fect activity to fill your weekend: A convention featuring more than 100 “meowchants,” cosplay, cat calling, and fab feline stars like Hannah Shaw, the Kitten Lady (Saturday) and Jackson Galaxy (Sunday).

events.title: Chum Salmon and Cider Celebration
events.loc: McClane Creek Nature Trail , 5044 Delphi Rd. S.W., Olympia
events.desc: Catch the salmon running in Olympia this weekend. While you’re there, stay warm with hot apple cider and fresh apple cider doughnuts. Hands-on activities are also part of the plan.
